about: The gaze bench's scenarios (README.md). Targets are fractions of the screen across (u) and down (v); 0 and 1 are the edges, as far out as a whole target fits. Generators: grid [cols, rows] over span; edges N per edge, corners included; rays: fractions of the way from the middle to the edge along dirs directions; random N with edge_share of them on an edge; pairs N, two targets gap px apart (click the filled one).

scenarios.name: Warm-up
scenarios.about: Nine targets in the middle of the screen.
scenarios.prompt: Look at the target, then click it.

scenarios.name: Screen edges
scenarios.about: Sixteen targets along the four edges and in the corners.
scenarios.prompt: Look at the target, then click it.

scenarios.name: Hold at the edges
scenarios.about: Look at an edge target for 3 seconds before you click: the tracker loses an eye out there.
scenarios.prompt: Keep looking at the target. Click when it turns white.

scenarios.name: Eyes only
scenarios.about: Keep your head facing the cross in the middle and move only your eyes, out to the edges.
scenarios.prompt: Keep your head facing the cross. Move only your eyes to the target, then click it.

scenarios.name: Turn to it
scenarios.about: The same places, but turn your head to face each target first.
scenarios.prompt: Turn your head to face the target, then click it.

scenarios.name: Light changes
scenarios.about: The screen switches between dark, bright and grey: your pupils change size.
scenarios.prompt: Look at the target, then click it.

scenarios.name: Small and close
scenarios.about: Two targets side by side: click the filled one.
scenarios.prompt: Look at the filled target, then click it.

scenarios.name: After a nudge
scenarios.about: Lift the headset a little and set it back, then nine targets: how fast the tracker recovers.
scenarios.message: First lift the headset a little off your face and set it back down.
scenarios.prompt: Look at the target, then click it.

scenarios.name: Long session
scenarios.about: Sixty targets anywhere on the screen at your own pace, about six minutes: drift, slips and stale corrections.
scenarios.prompt: Look at the target, then click it.
